patch.content:
# WireGuard VPN configuration options

# Copyright (c) 2026 Nordic Semiconductor ASA
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

menuconfig WIREGUARD
	bool "WireGuard VPN support [EXPERIMENTAL]"
	depends on NET_UDP
	depends on NET_SOCKETS
	depends on NET_SOCKETS_SERVICE
	select EXPERIMENTAL
	select PSA_CRYPTO
	select PSA_WANT_KEY_TYPE_ECC_KEY_PAIR_IMPORT
	select PSA_WANT_KEY_TYPE_ECC_KEY_PAIR_EXPORT
	select PSA_WANT_KEY_TYPE_ECC_KEY_PAIR_GENERATE
	select PSA_WANT_KEY_TYPE_ECC_PUBLIC_KEY
	select PSA_WANT_ECC_MONTGOMERY_255
	select PSA_WANT_ALG_ECDH
	select PSA_WANT_ALG_CHACHA20_POLY1305
	select PSA_WANT_KEY_TYPE_CHACHA20
	select NET_IF_NO_AUTO_START
	select NET_MGMT
	select NET_MGMT_EVENT
	select NET_MGMT_EVENT_INFO
	select NET_VPN
	help
	  Enable WireGuard VPN support.

if WIREGUARD

config WIREGUARD_MAX_PEERS
	int "Maximum number of WireGuard peers"
	default 2
	range 1 256
	help
	  The maximum number of peers that can be configured.

config WIREGUARD_MAX_SRC_IPS
	int "Maximum number of allowed IP addresses per peer"
	default 2
	range 1 32
	help
	  Each peer can have a list of allowed source IP addresses (with netmask).
	  This option sets the maximum number of allowed IP entries per peer.

config WIREGUARD_PORT
	int "Default UDP port for WireGuard"
	default 51820
	range 1 65535
	help
	  The default UDP port to listen on for incoming WireGuard packets.

config WIREGUARD_KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT
	int "Default persistent keepalive interval in seconds"
	default 25
	range 0 65535
	help
	  Default interval in seconds for sending keepalive packets to peers.
	  Set to 0 to disable keepalives by default.

config WIREGUARD_RX_QUEUE_LEN
	int "Length of the receive packet queue"
	default 4
	range 1 64
	help
	  Number of incoming packets that can be queued for processing by the
	  WireGuard service.

config WIREGUARD_BUF_ALLOC_TIMEOUT
	int "Timeout (in ms) for network buffer allocation"
	default 100
	range 10 5000
	help
	  Timeout in milliseconds when allocating network packets and buffers
	  for WireGuard packets.

config WIREGUARD_SHELL
	bool "WireGuard shell commands"
	depends on NET_SHELL
	default y
	help
	  Enable net shell commands for inspecting and managing WireGuard
	  interfaces and peers.

module = WIREGUARD
module-dep = NET_LOG
module-str = Log level for WireGuard
module-help = Enables WireGuard debug messages.
source "subsys/net/Kconfig.template.log_config.net"

endif # WIREGUARD
